title: Modality Module
description: Schema for modality-specific refinement modules. A modality_module layers on top of a biology-axis base dashboard_spec, declaring (1) additional cards required for the modality, (2) threshold overlays on shared base cards, (3) a headline decision question, (4) modality-specific caveats. Lives at target-contracts/dashboards/modality-modules/{modality}.module.yaml. See plan § Target Dashboard Architecture (A3) and the new § Dashboard / Interpretation / Inference Layers section.

modality_module.description: Modality identifier; must match a `value` in modality.enum.yaml.

extends_axes.description: Biology axes this module is compatible with (e.g., [surface_intrinsic] for ADC). Compose-dashboard refuses to load this module against a target whose axis is not in this list.

additional_cards.description: Cards this modality requires ON TOP OF the base dashboard's required_cards. May reference cards that are data-blocked at iter-1b — modality_module entries are aspirational where data is pending.

data_status.description: iter-1b operational status. data_blocked = catalog manifest pending; method_pending = method implementation pending.

threshold_overlays.description: Per-base-card threshold tuning. Keys are card_ids from the base dashboard; values are threshold-name → new-value mappings. Only certain fields are tunable — see `tunable_threshold_categories` constraint below.

additionalProperties.description: For card_id <key>, override these named thresholds. Threshold names must match the card_spec's thresholds: block keys.

tunable_threshold_categories.description: Whitelist of threshold categories this modality module is allowed to tune. NEVER includes statistical_significance or applies_when_predicate — those are not modality-tunable, only severity/weighting/note fields are.

headline_decision_question.description: The single-sentence question this modality is fundamentally asking. Surfaced in synthesis as the headline framing.

modality_specific_caveats.description: Caveats surfaced in every rendered package when this modality module is loaded. Distinct from per-card caveats — these are MODALITY-level concerns, not card-level limitations.

synthesis_emphasis.description: Synthesis layer directives specific to this modality. Controls which cards weight heaviest in the headline call.

primary_cards.description: Card_ids whose interpretation_calls drive the modality headline call.

modality_killer_conditions.description: Structured predicates that, if any one fires, downgrade the modality fit to 'not_viable' in phase-3 synthesis. Replaced free-prose strings (iter-1a) with structured `{card_id, predicate_type, predicate_value, message}` triples post-adversarial-review (iter-1b C1 fix). Phase-3's _check_killer_conditions evaluates each entry deterministically.

card_id.description: Card whose output triggers this killer condition.

predicate_type.description: What kind of check phase-3 performs against the card's output.

predicate_value.description: Value the predicate checks against. Type depends on predicate_type: string for *_equals, array of strings for *_in, boolean for excluded_by_applies_when, string for warning_id_fires.

message.description: Human-readable explanation surfaced in synthesis output when this condition fires.
